name: ref_cave_water_camera

arguments.prompt:
STYLE BIBLE (verbatim):
STYLE: this is a CONCEPT FRAME of one biome of the same game as Image 1, not a game asset. Match Image 1 exactly in rendering: dark-fantasy dungeon pixel art, every pixel a hard square of one flat colour on one even grid, the same pixel size, the same top-down 3/4 dungeon-crawler camera (floors seen from above, walls and props show their front faces), the same scale (the hero is about 55 pixels tall in a 1024-pixel-tall image), the same chunky stone-block walls with dark mortar, a 1-pixel dark outline around characters and props.
Light: lit exactly like Image 1 — warm or coloured pools of light around torches, candles and braziers, flames with white-hot cores, glowing emissive sources, strong falloff into deep shadow; the solid rock between rooms is pure black void; high contrast, low-key.
Palette: low-key and muted like Image 1 — charcoal and slate stone, rust and leather browns, deep reds, bone; saturated colour only in light sources and the biome accent.
Layout: one continuous play area seen from the game camera — 3 to 4 rooms joined by corridors and doorways, the rooms cut out of black rock, filling the whole frame edge to edge; the hero (red cape, steel breastplate, sword) stands in the middle room fighting 2-3 monsters. Everything walkable must stay reachable: any river, pit or deep pool is crossed by a bridge, a stone path or stepping stones.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no HUD, no panels, no minimap, no health bars, no logos, no watermark.

INPUT IMAGES:
Image 1: style reference: match style, palette, rendering and light; do not copy composition.
Image 2: selected Flooded Caves appearance: preserve calm surfaces, palette, materials and restrained detail; change camera and layout only.

ASSET:
Adapt Image 2, the player's selected Flooded Caves concept, to the gameplay camera of Image 1. Preserve Image 2's identity: dark blue-grey natural rock, calm deep teal water, moss, small luminous cyan mushrooms and blue crystals, warm explorer torches and a campfire. Preserve its broad quiet rock and water surfaces; detail belongs only on characters, crossings, focal props and the base of waterfalls.

CAMERA AND PLAYABILITY — highest priority: use Image 1's flat top-down 3/4 dungeon-crawler view, not an isometric diorama. Horizontal edges stay horizontal; no diagonal diamond layout. Floors are seen mainly from above. Cave boundary walls show a short front face only, about one low tile high. No tall cliffs, no high pillars, no foreground stalagmites hiding the floor. Show three broad connected caverns cut out of pure black rock, with a wide dry corridor between them. A continuous dry floor must visibly connect every cavern, bridge entrance, chest and camp.

The central combat cavern is a broad bank of natural stone and gravel, at least six hero heights across, with a red-caped steel-armoured swordsman fighting exactly three enemies: a blue-purple spider, a green goblin and a skeleton. Match the hero's on-screen size to the central fighting hero in Image 1. Keep the ground under the actors quiet and clearly visible. The other caverns contain a small explorer camp and a chest; never fill the walkable floor with rocks or props.

Water occupies 25–35 percent of the whole image: one calm winding underground river and one connected pool. Dark teal water has broad uninterrupted areas with sparse short highlights, not a dense all-over pattern of white ripples. A low timber bridge and a wide ford of flat stones cross the river. Include one short waterfall from a low rock opening, with foam restricted to its base, not several tall cascading cliffs. Round low cave rims, a few small edge rocks, patches of moss and pebbles, no masonry or tiled floors.

Low-key, muted palette and deep shadows; small warm light pools contrast with cold water, mushrooms and crystals. No global cyan wash, haze, glitter, texture noise or carpet of tiny specks. Keep the image as calm as the selected Image 2. Do not copy its elevated camera, high rock tiers or narrow disconnected islands. No HUD, text, labels or panels.

BACKGROUND:
Opaque image, composed edge to edge as described in the asset prompt.

Target canvas/aspect: 1536x1024. Keep important content within safe margins.

note: Prepared only. Codex must inspect references, call built-in imagegen directly, and import the returned local image.
